question: Which of the following pairs of (Plants-type) is correctly matched?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Opuntia - Xerophytic plant**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Nepenthes - Parasitic plant:** This statement is **incorrect**. Nepenthes, also known as the tropical pitcher plant, is an **insectivorous plant**, not a parasitic one. It traps and digests insects to supplement its nutrient requirements, especially nitrogen, in nutrient-poor soils.
 
• **Cuscuta - Insectivorous plant:** This statement is **incorrect**. Cuscuta, commonly known as dodder, is a **parasitic plant**. It attaches itself to host plants using specialized structures called haustoria, through which it absorbs nutrients and water from the host.
